charge_port.notes: Estimated: The Autopian review of the Canadian car says the port is "of the CCS variety rather than the Tesla-style NACS port" (CCS1 in North America). Review, not a Lotus statement.

wheels.notes: Australian spec page: S and R 22-inch (Eletre base 20-inch); Automotive World also gives 22-inch as the standard forged wheel outside Europe. Canadian market not confirmed, low confidence.
Lotus Canada Eletre specifications page shows a 23-inch forged wheel on the featured configuration; whether it is an option on these trims is not stated.
